purpose: Implement pipeline step execution with context cancellation and reliable cleanup
constraints: must check ctx.Err() before each step

tasks.title: Implement ExecutePipeline
tasks.context: Pipelines must halt promptly on context cancellation and clean up partial state.
tasks.why: Prevent zombie processes and resource leaks when user interrupts operations.

references.excerpt: func ExecutePipeline(ctx context.Context, steps []PipelineStep, onCleanup func()) (*PipelineResult, error)

decisions.chosen: Check ctx.Err() before step execution and pass ctx to Step.Run

steps.action: Check ctx.Err(). If canceled, call onCleanup and return ctx.Err()
Loop through steps. Check ctx.Err() before each, run step, handle error

interfaces: func ExecutePipeline(ctx context.Context, steps []PipelineStep, onCleanup func()) (*PipelineResult, error)
constraints: Must invoke onCleanup on cancellation or step failure
Must NOT invoke onCleanup on full success

examples.input: ctx with 3 steps, canceled after step 1
examples.output: Returns ctx.Err(), completed=1, onCleanup called once
examples.explanation: Stops pipeline without executing steps 2 and 3

acceptance.requirement: All steps executed to completion when context remains active
acceptance.expected: Returns CompletedCount=3, err=nil, onCleanup not called

acceptance.requirement: Execution halts on canceled context and calls onCleanup exactly once
acceptance.expected: Returns context.Canceled error, steps 3-4 never execute, onCleanup called once
